title: CANNAVARO'S UZBEKISTAN BLEW A 2-0 LEAD IN 9 MINUTES. HIS DREAM? ITALY
description:
Two-nil up. Three goals in nine minutes later, Uzbekistan had lost.

Uzbekistan led Russia 2-0. Then Russia scored three in nine minutes and won 3-2. Quicker than an espresso.

Five days later, Esanov scored twice in Doha and Uzbekistan beat Saudi Arabia 2-1.

He says he sometimes prefers equal or fewer men on the pitch, because the players show more spirit. Bold theory. He also calls the national-team job a quick Neapolitan coffee, about ten days, even though his contract runs to autumn 2027. And the dream job? Italy. For now, Uzbekistan is the audition.

Is Cannavaro already auditioning for Italy, or should he finish the job in Uzbekistan first? Where do you stand?
